changelog:
Initial release of the xiaohongshu-note-generator skill.

- Generates publish-ready social content-marketing notes from a user topic.
- Output includes catchy title, note body, emoji, and hashtags styled for popular lifestyle platforms.
- Supports custom style and formatting requests (tone, bullet points, word count, etc).
- Requires an API key from wsdsocial.com for use.
- Provides easy API setup and usage instructions in SKILL.md.
summary: Generate complete, publish-ready social content-marketing notes from a topic. Produces a fully-styled note — catchy title, body copy, emoji, and hashtags — matching popular social lifestyle-platform content style, ready to post. Use when the user wants to write a social seeding note, product-seeding copy, 种草文案, lifestyle/product recommendation note, or draft social content for content-marketing platforms. Trigger keywords: social note, content marketing, note generator, 笔记生成, copywriting, 文案, 种草, seeding, product recommendation. Requires an API key from wsdsocial.com.
